description: Share a whole collection: every endpoint in it (including ones added later), with its examples and latest run, read-only and with secrets hidden. Environments are never shown and it can't be exported. Returns the collection's link, which never changes. With no other arguments it stays restricted to the workspace; set `link_access` or `invite` people only when the user asks to share it outside the team. get_api_collection returns the link as `share` once it exists.

invite.description: People to invite by email (at most 10). Each gets an email.

link_access.description: Who can open it with just the link. Omit to keep the current setting (restricted for a new share).

name: share_api_collection
